properties.site-address: Land north of Osborne Road, New Milton
properties.notes: This town centre site is currently in use as a car park and as a car repair/sales garage. There is an opportunity for redevelopment of the site that optimises the use of the site and makes most efficient use of land. The Listed Broadway Tower will be an important consideration in any development proposal. Given its town centre location, the site could accommodate a well-designed high density mixed-use scheme comprising commercial uses on the ground floor and residential uses on upper floors. Redevelopment would have potential to bring visual/economic/social enhancements to New Milton town centre. Around 20 dwellings
